purpose: Diagnostic only; failed multi-card trades do not by themselves establish a strength regression or a prior-knowledge bug.
engine: real Session, strict apply without fallback
all_seats: same tested planner; initial peek slots 0 and 1
interpretation: Counts describe divergent self-play trajectories. Fewer failed trades is not evidence of higher match win rate. Ground-truth ranks were read only by the offline diagnostic after the command had been chosen; they were never supplied to the planner. The screenshot's exact prior knowledge cannot be recovered from its post-exposure display.
reproduce: cargo test --release --lib audit_speculative_exchanges -- --ignored --nocapture; experimental overrides through CABO_AUDIT_CFG

cycle_diagnostic.interpretation: This observation set did not encounter a rollout cycle; it cannot demonstrate improved sampling throughput from the new guard.
